__comment: Shared robot chassis cube + the 7.1.x eye/port decals + the display section restoring 7.1.x apparent sizes. All 12 robot chassis models (the bare fallback + 11 per-kind variants; robot_station is the docking station's own model and does NOT parent this) parent this file and only rebind textures. Provenance of each display value (verified against upstream/7.1.x RenderRobot.java and the Forge 1.7.10 surround): gui scale 1.0 draws the true-size 0.5-block cube in the standard block iso pose — 1.7.10 drew the same cube via BC glScaled(1.5) inside Forge's 10x isometric INVENTORY_BLOCK surround (~10.6px of the 16px slot; scale 1.0 at 30/225 reproduces that within a pixel, and 1.5 would clip: an iso cube projects 1.41x side wide, 1.57x tall). ground scale 0.3 / translation [0,2.2,0] = 1.7.10's dropped size (Forge glScalef(0.5) * BC glScaled(0.6) = 0.15 apparent) with the same +1/16 seat offset a vanilla block drop has. fixed scale 1.0 = true size in item frames, consistent with the inherited on_shelf context. The four hand contexts are deliberately ABSENT: block/block's firstperson 0.40 / thirdperson 0.375 equal 1.7.10's vanilla surround scales exactly (0.5*0.40=0.2 fp, 0.5*0.375=0.1875 tp), so inheritance IS hand parity. Display inheritance is per-context wholesale: every context present here must stay fully specified (a scale-only gui entry would reset rotation to 0). The second element is 7.1.x's decal pass: RenderRobot.doRenderRobot drew this same box two extra times, bound to overlay_side.png (the red eye marks) and overlay_bottom.png (the pale-cyan under-port); here the item copies of those exact textures land as the tintindex-0 #eye quads on the four sides (charge-tinted — 7.1.x modulated the decal's alpha by charge; the item sheet is alpha-cutout, so the tint multiplies the red toward black instead, same read) and the tintindex-1 #port quad underneath (always on, exactly as 7.1.x drew it at full alpha whenever the robot was awake). shade false keeps the decals equally bright on every face — 1.7.10's decal pass disabled lighting outright.
